title: Riffle outcome import
description: Body of POST /v1/outcomes. Lets an org report outcomes Riffle cannot see (internal reverts, incidents, internal CI). Signed with the secret named in rules sources.outcome_import. Imported outcomes become the external_import label source, weighted by its label_source rule. Idempotent on event_id. Never carries code or diffs.

event_id.description: Sender's unique id; resends are ignored

target.description: What the outcome is about. At least one key.

external_change_id.description: Matched through link rules, e.g. D12345678

source.description: Free label for audit, e.g. internal-ci
